info.name: S3 API
info.summary: Expose Nextcloud folders as S3-compatible buckets
info.description: This app exposes Nextcloud folders as S3-compatible buckets. Users can mark folders as buckets in their personal settings and create API keys (readonly/readwrite) per bucket. The API is accessible via path-style S3 requests and supports AWS Signature V4 authentication.
info.author: osuv
